title: motion-promo beats
description: Ordered shot list for the promo. Each app beat becomes a scene: captured still + optional highlight + kinetic callout. First/last beats are usually kinetic-type intro + CTA (no shot).

kind.description: intro=kinetic hook, app=captured screen w/ motion, cta=end card

route.description: app route to capture (kind:app). Omit if `still` is pre-supplied.

still.description: path to a pre-captured still under assets/, overrides route capture

waitFor.description: CSS selector to await before screenshot (defaults to 'main')

origin.description: transform-origin, aim at the hero element

highlight.description: spotlight box over the hero element, in STILL-pixel space (child of the scaled shot → tracks the zoom)

label.description: bracket label, e.g. RECEBIDO NO MÊS

headline.description: short bold headline, use \n for line break

text.description: for kind:intro / kind:cta — the kinetic copy

lines.description: hero lines; wrap the accent word in *asterisks*
